name: bank-word-long-access
source:
Reserve As Work 4,9
Doke Start(4)+1,43981
Loke Start(4)+3,-2147483647
Print Deek(Start(4)+1),Leek(Start(4)+3),Peek(Start(4))

encoding.notes: Explicit original token offsets and big-endian integer/line records, assembled independently with Python struct; no production token table or encoder.

evidence.notes: lib_in_doke/loke and lib_fn_deek/leek preserve big-endian values at odd addresses. Deek zero-extends a word; Leek returns the integer long bit pattern. Checked virtual bank ranges are AMOScript ownership bounds, not machine-address or bus timing emulation. No AMOS execution capture.
